<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>桐城自摸麻将 - 局域网版</title>
    <style>
        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        body {
            font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1a472a 0%, #2d5a3d 100%);
            min-height: 100vh;
            color: #fff;
        }

        /* 大厅样式 - 登录界面 */
        #loginScreen {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            background: rgba(13, 40, 24, 0.98);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            z-index: 200;
            overflow-y: auto;
            padding: 20px;
        }

        #loginScreen h1 {
            font-size: 48px;
            color: #ffd700;
            text-shadow: 0 0 20px #ffd700;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
            animation: glow 2s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
        }

        @keyframes glow {
            from { text-shadow: 0 0 10px #ffd700, 0 0 20px #ffd700; }
            to { text-shadow: 0 0 20px #ffd700, 0 0 40px #ffd700, 0 0 60px #ff8c00; }
        }

        #loginScreen .subtitle {
            color: #90ee90;
            font-size: 18px;
            margin-bottom: 30px;
        }

        .name-bar {
            display: flex;
            gap: 15px;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            padding: 20px;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
            border-radius: 10px;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }

        .name-bar label {
            color: #ffd700;
            font-size: 14px;
        }

        .name-bar input {
            width: 200px;
            padding: 10px 15px;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
            border: 2px solid #ffd700;
            border-radius: 8px;
            color: #fff;
            font-size: 16px;
        }

        .name-bar input:focus {
            outline: none;
            box-shadow: 0 0 15px #ffd700;
        }

        .name-bar input::placeholder {
            color: #666;
        }

        /* 牌桌列表容器 */
        .lobby-container {
            width: 90%;
            max-width: 800px;
            margin-top: 10px;
        }

        .lobby-header {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            padding: 0 10px;
        }

        .lobby-header h2 {
            color: #ffd700;
            font-size: 24px;
        }

        .btn {
            padding: 10px 20px;
            font-size: 16px;
            border: none;
            border-radius: 5px;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s;
        }

        .btn-primary {
            background: #4CAF50;
            color: white;
        }

        .btn-primary:hover {
            background: #45a049;
        }

        .btn-danger {
            background: #f44336;
            color: white;
        }

        .btn-secondary {
            background: #607D8B;
            color: white;
        }

        .table-list {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(200px, 1fr));
            gap: 15px;
            padding: 20px;
        }

        .table-card {
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: 15px;
            text-align: center;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s;
            border: 2px solid transparent;
        }

        .table-card:hover {
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
            transform: translateY(-2px);

        // 全局变量
        let ws = null;
        let playerId = null;
        let playerName = '';
        let currentTableId = null;
        let selectedCard = null;
        let gameState = null;
        let myIndex = 0;
        let isReady = false;

        // 连接WebSocket
        function connect() {
            const protocol = window.location.protocol === 'https:' ? 'wss:' : 'ws:';
            ws = new WebSocket(`${protocol}//${window.location.host}`);

            ws.onopen = () => {
                console.log('WebSocket已连接');
                // 连接后立即获取牌桌列表
                ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'getTableList' }));
            };

            ws.onmessage = (event) => {
                const data = JSON.parse(event.data);
                handleMessage(data);
            };

            ws.onclose = () => {
                console.log('WebSocket已断开');
                setTimeout(() => {
                    if (playerId) {
                        connect();
                    }
                }, 3000);
            };

            ws.onerror = (error) => {
                console.error('WebSocket错误:', error);
            };
        }

        // 处理消息
        function handleMessage(data) {
            switch (data.type) {
                case 'loginSuccess':
                    playerId = data.playerId;
                    playerName = data.playerName;
                    // 登录成功后获取牌桌列表
                    if (ws && ws.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
                        ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'getTableList' }));
                    }
                    break;

                case 'tableList':
                    renderTableList(data.tables);
                    break;

                case 'playerList':
                    renderPlayerList(data);
                    break;

                case 'dealStart':
                    // 开始发牌动画
                    showDealAnimation();
                    break;

                case 'gameState':
                    gameState = data.data;
                    myIndex = gameState.myIndex;
                    console.log('收到游戏状态:', gameState);
                    console.log('我的手牌:', gameState.myHand);
                    console.log('手牌数量:', gameState.myHand ? gameState.myHand.length : 0);
                    showGame();  // 确保显示游戏界面
                    updateGameUI();
                    break;

                case 'message':
                    addChatMessage(data.text);
                    break;

                case 'error':
                    alert(data.message);
                    break;
            }
        }

        // 确保已登录
        function ensureLogin(callback) {
            const name = document.getElementById('playerName').value.trim();
            if (!name) {
                alert('请先输入名称');
                return false;
            }

            if (!playerId || !playerName) {
                playerName = name;
                if (!ws || ws.readyState !== WebSocket.OPEN) {
                    connect();
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'login', name }));
                        if (callback) setTimeout(callback, 300);
                    }, 500);
                } else {
                    ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'login', name }));
                    if (callback) setTimeout(callback, 300);
                }
                return true;
            }
            return true;
        }

        // 登录
        function login() {
            const name = document.getElementById('playerName').value.trim();
            if (!name) {
                alert('请输入名字');
                return;
            }

            playerName = name;
            if (!ws || ws.readyState !== WebSocket.OPEN) {
                connect();
                setTimeout(() => {
                    ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'login', name }));
                }, 500);
            } else {
                ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'login', name }));
            }
        }

        // 退出

            playerId = null;

                const windMap = { '东': 'feng_dong', '南': 'feng_nan', '西': 'feng_xi', '北': 'feng_bei' };
                return windMap[card.rank] || '';
            } else if (card.type === 'arrow') {
                const arrowMap = { '中': 'jian_zhong', '发': 'jian_fa', '白': 'jian_bai' };
                return arrowMap[card.rank] || '';
            }
            return '';
        }

            } else if (card.type === 'wind') {

            } else if (card.type === 'arrow') {
                const arrowNames = { '中': '红中', '发': '发财', '白': '白板' };

            // 布局: 第0行(红中,1-9筒), 第1行(1-9条), 第2行(1-9万,東), 第3行(南西北中發白)
            const scale = 0.5;
            if (card.type === 'number') {
                let col, row;

                    col = parseInt(card.rank); // 筒子: 红中(0), 一筒(1), ..., 九筒(9)

                    col = parseInt(card.rank) - 1; // 条子: 一条(0), 二条(1), ..., 九条(8)

                    col = parseInt(card.rank) - 1; // 万子: 一万(0), 二万(1), ..., 九万(8)
                    row = 2;
                }
                hintCard.style.backgroundPosition = `calc((-${col} * 61.7px + 2px) * ${scale}) calc((-${row} * 93.25px + 4px) * ${scale})`;

                    hintCard.style.backgroundPosition = `calc((-9 * 61.7px + 2px) * ${scale}) calc((-2 * 93.25px + 4px) * ${scale})`;
                } else {
                    const windCols = { '南': 0, '西': 1, '北': 2 };
                    const col = windCols[card.rank];
                    hintCard.style.backgroundPosition = `calc((-${col} * 61.7px + 2px) * ${scale}) calc((-3 * 93.25px + 4px) * ${scale})`;
                }
            } else if (card.type === 'arrow') {
                // 箭牌: 中(3,3), 發(3,4), 白(3,5)
                const arrowCols = { '中': 3, '发': 4, '白': 5 };
                const col = arrowCols[card.rank];
                hintCard.style.backgroundPosition = `calc((-${col} * 61.7px + 2px) * ${scale}) calc((-3 * 93.25px + 4px) * ${scale})`;
            }

            hintText.textContent = getTileName(card);
        }

        // 拖拽相关变量
        let draggedCardId = null;

        function handleDragStart(e) {
            draggedCardId = e.target.dataset.cardId;
            e.target.classList.add('dragging');
            e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = 'move';
        }

        function handleDragEnd(e) {
            e.target.classList.remove('dragging');
            document.querySelectorAll('.card').forEach(card => {
                card.classList.remove('drag-over');
            });
            draggedCardId = null;
        }

        function handleDragOver(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.dataTransfer.dropEffect = 'move';
            const target = e.target.closest('.card');
            if (target && target.dataset.cardId !== draggedCardId) {
                target.classList.add('drag-over');
            }
        }

        function handleDragLeave(e) {
            const target = e.target.closest('.card');
            if (target) {
                target.classList.remove('drag-over');
            }
        }

        function handleDrop(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            const target = e.target.closest('.card');
            if (!target || !draggedCardId) return;

            const targetCardId = target.dataset.cardId;
            if (targetCardId === draggedCardId) return;

            // 重新排序手牌
            const fromIndex = gameState.myHand.findIndex(c => c.id === draggedCardId);
            const toIndex = gameState.myHand.findIndex(c => c.id === targetCardId);

            if (fromIndex !== -1 && toIndex !== -1) {
                const [movedCard] = gameState.myHand.splice(fromIndex, 1);
                gameState.myHand.splice(toIndex, 0, movedCard);
                renderMyHand();
            }

            target.classList.remove('drag-over');
        }

    <script>
        // 全局变量
        let ws = null;
        let playerId = null;
        let playerName = '';
        let currentTableId = null;
        let selectedCard = null;
        let gameState = null;
        let myIndex = 0;
        let isReady = false;

        // 连接WebSocket
        function connect() {
            const protocol = window.location.protocol === 'https:' ? 'wss:' : 'ws:';
            ws = new WebSocket(`${protocol}//${window.location.host}`);

            ws.onopen = () => {
                console.log('WebSocket已连接');
                // 连接后立即获取牌桌列表
                ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'getTableList' }));
            };

            ws.onmessage = (event) => {
                const data = JSON.parse(event.data);
                handleMessage(data);
            };

            ws.onclose = () => {
                console.log('WebSocket已断开');
                setTimeout(() => {
                    if (playerId) {
                        connect();
                    }
                }, 3000);
            };

            ws.onerror = (error) => {
                console.error('WebSocket错误:', error);
            };
        }

        // 处理消息
        function handleMessage(data) {
            switch (data.type) {
                case 'loginSuccess':
                    playerId = data.playerId;
                    playerName = data.playerName;
                    // 登录成功后获取牌桌列表
                    if (ws && ws.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
                        ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'getTableList' }));
                    }
                    break;

                case 'tableList':
                    renderTableList(data.tables);
                    break;

                case 'playerList':
                    renderPlayerList(data);
                    break;

                case 'dealStart':
                    // 开始发牌动画
                    showDealAnimation();
                    break;

                case 'gameState':
                    gameState = data.data;
                    myIndex = gameState.myIndex;
                    console.log('收到游戏状态:', gameState);
                    console.log('我的手牌:', gameState.myHand);
                    console.log('手牌数量:', gameState.myHand ? gameState.myHand.length : 0);
                    showGame();  // 确保显示游戏界面
                    updateGameUI();
                    break;

                case 'message':
                    addChatMessage(data.text);
                    break;

                case 'error':
                    alert(data.message);
                    break;
            }
        }

        // 确保已登录
        function ensureLogin(callback) {
            const name = document.getElementById('playerName').value.trim();
            if (!name) {
                alert('请先输入名称');
                return false;
            }

            if (!playerId || !playerName) {
                playerName = name;
                if (!ws || ws.readyState !== WebSocket.OPEN) {
                    connect();
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'login', name }));
                        if (callback) setTimeout(callback, 300);
                    }, 500);
                } else {
                    ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'login', name }));
                    if (callback) setTimeout(callback, 300);
                }
                return true;
            }
            return true;
        }

        // 登录
        function login() {
            const name = document.getElementById('playerName').value.trim();
            if (!name) {
                alert('请输入名字');
                return;
            }

            playerName = name;
            if (!ws || ws.readyState !== WebSocket.OPEN) {
                connect();
                setTimeout(() => {
                    ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'login', name }));
                }, 500);
            } else {
                ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'login', name }));
            }
        }

        // 退出
        function logout() {
            if (currentTableId) {
                leaveTable();
            }
            playerId = null;
            playerName = '';
        }

        // 渲染牌桌列表
        function renderTableList(tables) {
            const container = document.getElementById('tableList');
            container.innerHTML = '';

            // 创建新桌卡片
            const createCard = document.createElement('div');
            createCard.className = 'table-card create-table-card';
            createCard.innerHTML = `
                <div class="plus">+</div>
                <div class="text">开房</div>
            `;
            createCard.onclick = createTable;
            container.appendChild(createCard);

            // 现有牌桌
            tables.forEach((table, index) => {
                const card = document.createElement('div');
                const isFull = table.playerCount >= 4;
                const isPlaying = table.started;

                card.className = `table-card ${isFull ? 'full' : ''} ${isPlaying ? 'playing' : ''}`;

                // 生成圆桌座位显示
                let seatsHtml = '';
                for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                    const seatNum = i + 1;
                    const player = table.players.find(p => p.seatNum === seatNum);
                    const occupied = !!player;
                    const occupiedClass = occupied ? 'occupied' : '';
                    const clickHandler = (!occupied && !isPlaying) ? `onclick="event.stopPropagation(); joinTableById('${table.id}', ${seatNum})"` : '';
                    const title = occupied && player ? player.name : (isPlaying ? '' : '点击加入');
                    const displayChar = occupied ? (player ? player.name.charAt(0) : '?') : '+';

                    seatsHtml += `
                        <div class="mini-seat mini-seat-${seatNum}">
                            <div class="mini-seat-avatar ${occupiedClass}" ${clickHandler} title="${title}">
                                ${displayChar}
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    `;
                }

                // 状态文字
                let statusText = `${table.playerCount}/4 人`;
                let statusClass = '';
                let deckInfo = '';
                if (isPlaying) {
                    const deckCount = table.deckCount !== undefined ? table.deckCount : '?';
                    deckInfo = `<div class="deck-info">剩余: ${deckCount}张</div>`;
                    statusText = '🀄 游戏中';
                    statusClass = 'playing';
                } else if (isFull) {
                    statusText = '已满员';
                    statusClass = 'full';
                }

                card.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="table-header">
                        <div class="table-id">牌桌：${table.tableNumber}</div>
                        <div class="table-mode-badge">${isPlaying ? '游戏中' : '等待中'}</div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="mini-table-layout">
                        <div class="mini-table-center">🀄</div>
                        ${seatsHtml}
                    </div>
                    <div class="table-footer ${statusClass}">${statusText}</div>
                    ${deckInfo}
                `;

                // 点击整个卡片也可以加入（如果未满且未开始）
                if (!isFull && !isPlaying) {
                    card.onclick = () => joinTableById(table.id);
                }

                container.appendChild(card);
            });
        }

        // 通过ID加入牌桌
        function joinTableById(tableId, seatNum = null) {
            joinTable(tableId, seatNum);
        }

        // 创建牌桌
        function createTable() {
            if (!ensureLogin(() => {
                if (ws && ws.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
                    ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'createTable' }));
                }
            })) {
                if (playerId && ws && ws.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
                    ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'createTable' }));
                }
            }
        }

        // 加入牌桌
        function joinTable(tableId, seatNum = null) {
            if (!ensureLogin(() => {
                if (ws && ws.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
                    ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'joinTable', tableId, seatNum }));
                    currentTableId = tableId;
                }
            })) {
                if (playerId && ws && ws.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
                    ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'joinTable', tableId, seatNum }));
                    currentTableId = tableId;
                }
            }
        }

        // 离开牌桌
        function leaveTable() {
            showLobby();
            currentTableId = null;
            isReady = false;
        }

        // 显示大厅
        function showLobby() {
            document.getElementById('loginScreen').style.display = 'flex';
            document.getElementById('gameContainer').style.display = 'none';
            if (ws && ws.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
                ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'getTableList' }));
            }
        }

        // 显示游戏界面
        function showGame() {
            document.getElementById('loginScreen').style.display = 'none';
            document.getElementById('gameContainer').style.display = 'block';
        }

        // 渲染玩家列表
        function renderPlayerList(data) {
            showGame();

            document.getElementById('tableNumDisplay').textContent = data.tableNumber;

            // 更新准备面板
            const seatList = document.getElementById('seatList');
            seatList.innerHTML = '';

            const players = data.players || [];
            for (let i = 1; i <= 4; i++) {
                const player = players.find(p => p.seatNum === i);
                const div = document.createElement('div');
                div.className = 'seat-item';

                if (player) {
                    div.classList.add('occupied');
                    if (player.id === playerId) {
                        div.classList.add('me');
                    }
                    div.innerHTML = `
                        <div><strong>${i}号位</strong></div>
                        <div>${player.name} ${player.ready ? '✓已准备' : ''}</div>
                    `;
                } else {
                    div.innerHTML = `
                        <div><strong>${i}号位</strong></div>
                        <div>空位</div>
                    `;
                }
                seatList.appendChild(div);
            }

            // 游戏已开始，隐藏准备面板
            if (data.started) {
                document.getElementById('readyPanel').classList.add('hidden');
            } else {
                document.getElementById('readyPanel').classList.remove('hidden');
            }

            // 更新准备按钮
            const myPlayer = players.find(p => p.id === playerId);
            isReady = myPlayer ? myPlayer.ready : false;
            document.getElementById('readyBtn').textContent = isReady ? '取消准备' : '准备';
        }

        // 切换准备状态
        function toggleReady() {
            isReady = !isReady;
            ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'ready', ready: isReady }));
        }

        // 发牌动画
        function showDealAnimation() {
            const dealAnimation = document.getElementById('dealAnimation');
            const dealPiles = document.getElementById('dealPiles');
            const dealInfo = document.getElementById('dealInfo');
            const dealProgress = document.getElementById('dealProgress');

            dealAnimation.classList.remove('hidden');
            dealPiles.innerHTML = '';

            // 创建四堆牌（每堆17张，两层）
            for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                const pile = document.createElement('div');
                pile.className = 'deal-pile';
                pile.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="deal-pile-label">${i + 1}号位</div>
                    <div class="deal-pile-cards" id="pile${i}"></div>
                `;
                dealPiles.appendChild(pile);
            }

            // 动画展示牌堆
            dealInfo.textContent = '展示牌堆...';
            let cardIndex = 0;
            const totalCards = 68; // 4人 × 17张

            const addCard = setInterval(() => {
                if (cardIndex >= totalCards) {
                    clearInterval(addCard);
                    dealInfo.textContent = '发牌中...';
                    // 开始发牌动画
                    startDealing();
                    return;
                }

                const pileIndex = cardIndex % 4;
                const pile = document.getElementById(`pile${pileIndex}`);
                if (pile) {
                    const card = document.createElement('div');
                    card.className = 'deal-card-back';
                    pile.appendChild(card);
                }

                cardIndex++;
                dealProgress.textContent = `${cardIndex} / ${totalCards}`;
            }, 30);
        }

        // 发牌动画
        function startDealing() {
            const dealInfo = document.getElementById('dealInfo');
            const dealProgress = document.getElementById('dealProgress');

            let round = 0;
            let player = 0;
            let cardInRound = 0;
            const totalRounds = 4; // 4轮发牌

            const dealCard = setInterval(() => {
                if (round >= totalRounds) {
                    clearInterval(dealCard);
                    dealInfo.textContent = '发牌完成！';
                    // 隐藏发牌动画，显示游戏界面
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        document.getElementById('dealAnimation').classList.add('hidden');
                    }, 500);
                    return;
                }

                // 从牌堆移除一张牌
                const piles = document.querySelectorAll('.deal-pile-cards');
                for (let p of piles) {
                    if (p.lastChild) {
                        p.removeChild(p.lastChild);
                        break;
                    }
                }

                cardInRound++;
                if (cardInRound >= 4) {
                    cardInRound = 0;
                    round++;
                }

                dealProgress.textContent = `第 ${round + 1} 轮`;
            }, 100);
        }

        // 更新游戏UI
        function updateGameUI() {
            if (!gameState) return;

            // 游戏开始后隐藏准备面板和发牌动画
            if (gameState.started) {
                document.getElementById('readyPanel').classList.add('hidden');
                document.getElementById('dealAnimation').classList.add('hidden');
            }

            // 更新万能牌
            if (gameState.wildCard) {
                document.getElementById('wildCardDisplay').textContent =
                    getCardDisplayName(gameState.wildCard);
            }

            // 更新牌堆数量
            document.getElementById('deckCount').textContent = gameState.deckCount;

            // 更新游戏时间
            if (gameState.totalGameTime !== undefined) {
                const minutes = Math.floor(gameState.totalGameTime / 60);
                const seconds = gameState.totalGameTime % 60;
                const timeEl = document.getElementById('beijingTime');
                if (timeEl) {
                    timeEl.textContent =
                        `${minutes.toString().padStart(2, '0')}:${seconds.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
                }
            }

            // 更新各玩家信息
            // 先找到自己的座位号
            let mySeatNum = 1;
            for (const [pid, info] of Object.entries(gameState.playerInfo)) {
                if (pid === Object.keys(gameState.playerInfo)[myIndex]) {
                    mySeatNum = info.seatNum;
                    break;
                }
            }

            console.log('我的座位号:', mySeatNum);

            // 根据座位号计算显示位置
            // position: 0=bottom(自己), 1=right, 2=top, 3=left
            for (let seatNum = 1; seatNum <= 4; seatNum++) {
                // 计算相对位置
                let relativePos = (seatNum - mySeatNum + 4) % 4;

                // 映射到UI位置: 0->1(bottom), 1->2(right), 2->3(top), 3->4(left)
                const posNames = ['player1', 'player2', 'player3', 'player4'];
                const posName = posNames[relativePos];

                console.log(`座位${seatNum} -> 相对位置${relativePos} -> UI元素${posName}`);

                // 找到这个座位的玩家
                let foundPlayer = null;
                for (const [pid, info] of Object.entries(gameState.playerInfo)) {
                    if (info.seatNum === seatNum) {
                        foundPlayer = info;
                        break;
                    }
                }

                const nameEl = document.getElementById(`${posName}Name`);
                const countEl = document.getElementById(`${posName}Count`);
                const infoEl = document.getElementById(`${posName}Info`);
                const showedEl = document.getElementById(`${posName}Showed`);

                if (!nameEl || !countEl || !infoEl || !showedEl) {
                    console.error('找不到元素:', posName);
                    continue;
                }

                if (foundPlayer) {
                    nameEl.textContent = foundPlayer.name;
                    countEl.textContent = foundPlayer.handCount;

                    // 高亮当前玩家
                    if (gameState.currentPlayerSeat === seatNum) {
                        infoEl.classList.add('active');
                        nameEl.classList.add('current-turn');
                    } else {
                        infoEl.classList.remove('active');
                        nameEl.classList.remove('current-turn');
                    }

                    // 展示区
                    showedEl.innerHTML = '';

                    if (foundPlayer.showedCards) {
                        foundPlayer.showedCards.fa.forEach(card => {
                            const div = document.createElement('div');
                            div.className = 'showed-card fa';
                            div.textContent = '發';
                            showedEl.appendChild(div);
                        });

                        foundPlayer.showedCards.gang.forEach(gang => {
                            gang.forEach(card => {
                                const div = document.createElement('div');
                                div.className = 'showed-card gang';
                                div.textContent = getCardShortName(card);
                                showedEl.appendChild(div);
                            });
                        });
                    }
                }
            }

            // 更新自己的手牌
            renderMyHand();

            // 更新按钮状态
            const isMyTurn = gameState.currentPlayer === myIndex;
            document.getElementById('playBtn').disabled = !isMyTurn || !selectedCard;
            document.getElementById('faBtn').disabled = !gameState.canChangeFa;
            document.getElementById('gangBtn').disabled = !gameState.canGang;

            // 更新回合提示
            updateTurnIndicator();
        }

        // 更新回合提示
        function updateTurnIndicator() {
            const turnIndicator = document.getElementById('turnIndicator');
            const handArea = document.getElementById('myHand');

            if (!gameState || !gameState.started) {
                turnIndicator.textContent = '等待开始...';
                turnIndicator.classList.remove('my-turn');
                handArea.classList.remove('my-turn');
                return;
            }

            // 找到当前玩家的名字
            let currentPlayerName = '';
            for (const [pid, info] of Object.entries(gameState.playerInfo)) {
                if (info.seatNum === gameState.currentPlayerSeat) {
                    currentPlayerName = info.name;
                    break;
                }
            }

            const isMyTurn = gameState.currentPlayer === myIndex;

            if (isMyTurn) {
                turnIndicator.textContent = '🎯 轮到你出牌！';
                turnIndicator.classList.add('my-turn');
                handArea.classList.add('my-turn');
            } else {
                turnIndicator.textContent = `轮到 ${currentPlayerName} 出牌`;
                turnIndicator.classList.remove('my-turn');
                handArea.classList.remove('my-turn');
            }
        }

        // 获取牌对应的精灵图CSS类名
        function getTileSpriteClass(card) {
            if (card.type === 'number') {
                if (card.suit === '筒') {
                    return `tong${card.rank}`;
                } else if (card.suit === '条') {
                    return `tiao${card.rank}`;
                } else if (card.suit === '万') {
                    return `wan${card.rank}`;
                }
            } else if (card.type === 'wind') {
                const windMap = { '东': 'feng_dong', '南': 'feng_nan', '西': 'feng_xi', '北': 'feng_bei' };
                return windMap[card.rank] || '';
            } else if (card.type === 'arrow') {
                const arrowMap = { '中': 'jian_zhong', '发': 'jian_fa', '白': 'jian_bai' };
                return arrowMap[card.rank] || '';
            }
            return '';
        }

        // 获取牌的显示名称
        function getTileName(card) {
            if (!card) return '请选择一张牌';
            if (card.type === 'number') {
                return `${card.rank}${card.suit}`;
            } else if (card.type === 'wind') {
                return `${card.rank}风`;
            } else if (card.type === 'arrow') {
                const arrowNames = { '中': '红中', '发': '发财', '白': '白板' };
                return arrowNames[card.rank] || card.rank;
            }
            return '未知牌';
        }

        // 更新手牌提示区
        function updateHandHint(card) {
            const hintCard = document.getElementById('handHintCard');
            const hintText = document.getElementById('handHintText');

            if (!card) {
                hintCard.className = 'hand-hint-card';
                hintCard.style.backgroundImage = '';
                hintCard.style.backgroundSize = '';
                hintCard.style.backgroundPosition = '';
                hintText.textContent = '请选择一张牌';
                return;
            }

            // 设置牌面样式
            const tileClass = getTileSpriteClass(card);
            hintCard.className = 'hand-hint-card tile-sprite-hint ' + (tileClass || '');

            // 复制精灵图样式到提示区
            hintCard.style.backgroundImage = "url('麻将大图.jpg')";
            hintCard.style.backgroundSize = 'calc(617px * 0.5) calc(373px * 0.5)';

            // 计算背景位置 - 与CSS精灵图位置保持一致
            // 布局: 第0行(红中,1-9筒), 第1行(1-9条), 第2行(1-9万,東), 第3行(南西北中發白)
            const scale = 0.5;
            if (card.type === 'number') {
                let col, row;
                if (card.suit === '筒') {
                    col = parseInt(card.rank); // 筒子: 红中(0), 一筒(1), ..., 九筒(9)
                    row = 0;
                } else if (card.suit === '条') {
                    col = parseInt(card.rank) - 1; // 条子: 一条(0), 二条(1), ..., 九条(8)
                    row = 1;
                } else if (card.suit === '万') {
                    col = parseInt(card.rank) - 1; // 万子: 一万(0), 二万(1), ..., 九万(8)
                    row = 2;
                }
                hintCard.style.backgroundPosition = `calc((-${col} * 61.7px + 2px) * ${scale}) calc((-${row} * 93.25px + 4px) * ${scale})`;
            } else if (card.type === 'wind') {
                // 風牌: 東在第2行列9, 南西北在第3行列0-2
                if (card.rank === '东') {
                    hintCard.style.backgroundPosition = `calc((-9 * 61.7px + 2px) * ${scale}) calc((-2 * 93.25px + 4px) * ${scale})`;
                } else {
                    const windCols = { '南': 0, '西': 1, '北': 2 };
                    const col = windCols[card.rank];
                    hintCard.style.backgroundPosition = `calc((-${col} * 61.7px + 2px) * ${scale}) calc((-3 * 93.25px + 4px) * ${scale})`;
                }
            } else if (card.type === 'arrow') {
                // 箭牌: 中(3,3), 發(3,4), 白(3,5)
                const arrowCols = { '中': 3, '发': 4, '白': 5 };
                const col = arrowCols[card.rank];
                hintCard.style.backgroundPosition = `calc((-${col} * 61.7px + 2px) * ${scale}) calc((-3 * 93.25px + 4px) * ${scale})`;
            }

            hintText.textContent = getTileName(card);
        }

        // 渲染自己的手牌
        function renderMyHand() {
            const container = document.getElementById('myHand');
            container.innerHTML = '';

            console.log('renderMyHand 被调用, gameState:', gameState ? '存在' : '不存在');
            console.log('myHand:', gameState?.myHand);

            if (!gameState || !gameState.myHand) {
                console.log('没有手牌数据，返回');
                return;
            }

            console.log('开始渲染手牌，数量:', gameState.myHand.length);

            gameState.myHand.forEach(card => {
                const div = document.createElement('div');
                div.className = 'tile-sprite';

                // 添加对应的牌面类
                const tileClass = getTileSpriteClass(card);
                if (tileClass) {
                    div.classList.add(tileClass);
                }

                // 判断是否是万能牌
                const isWild = isWildCard(card);
                if (isWild) {
                    div.classList.add('wild');
                }

                // 选中状态
                if (selectedCard && selectedCard.id === card.id) {
                    div.classList.add('selected');
                }

                div.onclick = () => selectCard(card);
                div.dataset.cardId = card.id;

                // 拖拽功能
                div.draggable = true;
                div.addEventListener('dragstart', handleDragStart);
                div.addEventListener('dragend', handleDragEnd);
                div.addEventListener('dragover', handleDragOver);
                div.addEventListener('drop', handleDrop);
                div.addEventListener('dragleave', handleDragLeave);

                container.appendChild(div);
            });
        }

        // 创建筒子圆点
        function createDots(count) {
            let dots = '';
            for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
                dots += '<div class="dot"></div>';
            }
            return dots;
        }

        // 创建条子竹节
        function createBamboo(count) {
            let bamboo = '';
            if (count === 1) {
                bamboo = '<div class="bamboo-stick"></div>';
            } else if (count === 2) {
                bamboo = '<div class="bamboo-row"><div class="bamboo-stick"></div></div><div class="bamboo-row"><div class="bamboo-stick"></div></div>';
            } else if (count === 3) {
                bamboo = '<div class="bamboo-row"><div class="bamboo-stick"></div></div><div class="bamboo-row"><div class="bamboo-stick"></div><div class="bamboo-stick"></div></div>';
            } else if (count === 4) {
                bamboo = '<div class="bamboo-row"><div class="bamboo-stick"></div><div class="bamboo-stick"></div></div><div class="bamboo-row"><div class="bamboo-stick"></div><div class="bamboo-stick"></div></div>';
            } else if (count === 5) {
                bamboo = '<div class="bamboo-row"><div class="bamboo-stick"></div><div class="bamboo-stick"></div></div><div class="bamboo-row"><div class="bamboo-stick"></div></div><div class="bamboo-row"><div class="bamboo-stick"></div><div class="bamboo-stick"></div></div>';
            } else if (count === 6) {
                bamboo = '<div class="bamboo-row"><div class="bamboo-stick"></div><div class="bamboo-stick"></div></div><div class="bamboo-row"><div class="bamboo-stick"></div><div class="bamboo-stick"></div></div><div class="bamboo-row"><div class="bamboo-stick"></div><div class="bamboo-stick"></div></div>';
            } else if (count === 7) {
                bamboo = '<div class="bamboo-row"><div class="bamboo-stick"></div><div class="bamboo-stick"></div><div class="bamboo-stick"></div></div><div class="bamboo-row"><div class="bamboo-stick"></div><div class="bamboo-stick"></div></div><div class="bamboo-row"><div class="bamboo-stick"></div><div class="bamboo-stick"></div></div>';
            } else if (count === 8) {
                bamboo = '<div class="bamboo-row"><div class="bamboo-stick"></div><div class="bamboo-stick"></div></div><div class="bamboo-row"><div class="bamboo-stick"></div><div class="bamboo-stick"></div><div class="bamboo-stick"></div></div><div class="bamboo-row"><div class="bamboo-stick"></div><div class="bamboo-stick"></div><div class="bamboo-stick"></div></div>';
            } else if (count === 9) {
                bamboo = '<div class="bamboo-row"><div class="bamboo-stick"></div><div class="bamboo-stick"></div><div class="bamboo-stick"></div></div><div class="bamboo-row"><div class="bamboo-stick"></div><div class="bamboo-stick"></div><div class="bamboo-stick"></div></div><div class="bamboo-row"><div class="bamboo-stick"></div><div class="bamboo-stick"></div><div class="bamboo-stick"></div></div>';
            }
            return bamboo;
        }

        // 拖拽相关变量
        let draggedCardId = null;

        function handleDragStart(e) {
            draggedCardId = e.target.dataset.cardId;
            e.target.classList.add('dragging');
            e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = 'move';
        }

        function handleDragEnd(e) {
            e.target.classList.remove('dragging');
            document.querySelectorAll('.card').forEach(card => {
                card.classList.remove('drag-over');
            });
            draggedCardId = null;
        }

        function handleDragOver(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.dataTransfer.dropEffect = 'move';
            const target = e.target.closest('.card');
            if (target && target.dataset.cardId !== draggedCardId) {
                target.classList.add('drag-over');
            }
        }

        function handleDragLeave(e) {
            const target = e.target.closest('.card');
            if (target) {
                target.classList.remove('drag-over');
            }
        }

        function handleDrop(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            const target = e.target.closest('.card');
            if (!target || !draggedCardId) return;

            const targetCardId = target.dataset.cardId;
            if (targetCardId === draggedCardId) return;

            // 重新排序手牌
            const fromIndex = gameState.myHand.findIndex(c => c.id === draggedCardId);
            const toIndex = gameState.myHand.findIndex(c => c.id === targetCardId);

            if (fromIndex !== -1 && toIndex !== -1) {
                const [movedCard] = gameState.myHand.splice(fromIndex, 1);
                gameState.myHand.splice(toIndex, 0, movedCard);
                renderMyHand();
            }

            target.classList.remove('drag-over');
        }

        // 判断是否是万能牌
        function isWildCard(card) {
            if (!gameState || !gameState.wildCard) {
                console.log('isWildCard: 没有gameState或wildCard');
                return false;
            }
            const wild = gameState.wildCard;

            // 调试：打印比较信息
            console.log('比较牌:', JSON.stringify(card), '万能牌:', JSON.stringify(wild));

            // 检查是否与翻出的牌相同（精确匹配花色、点数、类型）
            const sameCard = (card.suit === wild.suit &&
                             String(card.rank) === String(wild.rank) &&
                             card.type === wild.type);

            if (sameCard) {
                console.log('匹配：与翻出的牌相同');
                return true;
            }

            // 红中永远是万能牌
            if (card.type === 'arrow' && card.rank === '中') {
                console.log('匹配：红中是万能牌');
                return true;
            }

            return false;
        }

        // 获取牌的短名称
        function getCardShortName(card) {
            if (card.type === 'number') {
                return card.rank;
            } else {
                return card.rank;
            }
        }

        // 获取牌的显示名称
        function getCardDisplayName(card) {
            if (card.type === 'number') {
                return `${card.rank}${card.suit}`;
            } else if (card.type === 'wind') {
                return card.rank;
            } else {
                return card.rank;
            }
        }

        // 选择牌
        function selectCard(card) {
            if (selectedCard && selectedCard.id === card.id) {
                selectedCard = null;
            } else {
                selectedCard = card;
            }

            // 如果是自己回合且有选中的牌，启用出牌按钮
            const isMyTurn = gameState && gameState.currentPlayer === myIndex;
            document.getElementById('playBtn').disabled = !isMyTurn || !selectedCard;

            renderMyHand();
        }

        // 出牌
        function playCard() {
            if (!selectedCard) return;

            ws.send(JSON.stringify({
                type: 'play',
                cardId: selectedCard.id
            }));

            selectedCard = null;
        }

        // 换发
        // 换發
        function changeFa() {
            ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'changeFa' }));
        }

        // 暗杠
        function doGang() {
            if (selectedCard) {
                ws.send(JSON.stringify({
                    type: 'gang',
                    cardId: selectedCard.id
                }));
            }
        }

        // 胡牌
        function declareHu() {
            ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'hu' }));
        }

        // 聊天
        function sendChat() {
            const input = document.getElementById('chatInput');
            const text = input.value.trim();
            if (text) {
                ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'chat', text }));
                input.value = '';
            }
        }

        function handleChatKey(event) {
            if (event.key === 'Enter') {
                sendChat();
            }
        }

        // 添加聊天消息
        function addChatMessage(text) {
            const container = document.getElementById('chatMessages');
            const div = document.createElement('div');
            div.textContent = text;
            div.style.marginBottom = '5px';
            container.appendChild(div);
            container.scrollTop = container.scrollHeight;
        }

        // 更新北京时间
        function updateBeijingTime() {
            const now = new Date();
            // 获取北京时间 (UTC+8)
            const beijingTime = new Date(now.toLocaleString('en-US', { timeZone: 'Asia/Shanghai' }));
            const hours = String(beijingTime.getHours()).padStart(2, '0');
            const minutes = String(beijingTime.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0');
            document.getElementById('beijingTime').textContent = `${hours}:${minutes}`;
        }

        // 掷骰子
        let diceValues = [0, 0];
        function rollDice() {
            const dice1 = document.getElementById('dice1');
            const dice2 = document.getElementById('dice2');
            const btn = document.getElementById('rollDiceBtn');

            btn.disabled = true;
            dice1.classList.add('rolling');
            dice2.classList.add('rolling');

            let count = 0;
            const interval = setInterval(() => {
                dice1.textContent = Math.floor(Math.random() * 6) + 1;
                dice2.textContent = Math.floor(Math.random() * 6) + 1;
                count++;

                if (count >= 10) {
                    clearInterval(interval);
                    dice1.classList.remove('rolling');
                    dice2.classList.remove('rolling');

                    // 最终结果
                    diceValues[0] = Math.floor(Math.random() * 6) + 1;
                    diceValues[1] = Math.floor(Math.random() * 6) + 1;
                    dice1.textContent = diceValues[0];
                    dice2.textContent = diceValues[1];

                    // 发送骰子结果给服务器
                    if (ws && ws.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
                        ws.send(JSON.stringify({
                            type: 'diceRoll',
                            values: diceValues
                        }));
                    }

                    setTimeout(() => {
                        btn.disabled = false;
                    }, 1000);
                }
            }, 100);
        }

        // 初始化
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            connect();
            // 启动北京时间更新
            updateBeijingTime();
            setInterval(updateBeijingTime, 1000);
        });
    </script>
</body>
